scenes.headline: RONALDO’S GOODBYE
scenes.narration: Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international football. I’m Korean, but this is still one of those headlines that makes me check my own age.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: The announcement came on November fifth, after more than two decades in the national team. That’s longer than most of my habits have lasted.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: One hundred and forty-six international goals, Euro two thousand sixteen, and Nations League titles in twenty nineteen and twenty twenty-five. Quite a CV.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: He’s retiring from international football. That’s the part I’m talking about, before this turns into an obituary for his entire career.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: I’m not expecting him to disappear quietly. But it’s strange when somebody who always seemed permanent starts clearing out one locker.

scenes.headline: ONE LAST SHIFT
scenes.narration: NASA’s Swift observatory finally clocked out. It reentered Earth’s atmosphere on November fourth, after almost twenty-two years in orbit. That’s a very long shift.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: It reentered over Indonesia’s North Sumatra region. NASA expected most of the spacecraft to burn up, though some components may have survived.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: Swift was meant to work for two years, studying cosmic explosions. Instead it kept going for almost twenty two. I respect that.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: An attempt to rescue it earlier this year failed. Space apparently has its own disappointing customer service. I wasn’t expecting that part.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: The data work continues at the University of Leicester. Here in Korea, I recognise that arrangement: leaving the office doesn’t end the work.

scenes.headline: 덜 팔고 더 벌었다
scenes.narration: 닌텐도, 덜 팔고 더 벌었다. 스위치 투 얘기예요. 처음엔 기사 두 개를 잘못 붙여 놓은 줄 알았어요.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: 오늘 나온 반기 실적을 보면, 본체 판매는 작년 같은 기간보다 삼십칠 퍼센트쯤 줄었어요. 그런데 영업이익은 사십구 퍼센트나 늘었고요.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: 게임이 차지하는 매출 비중이 커졌고, 미국에서 관세를 돌려받은 영향도 있었대요. 기계 몇 대 팔았는지만 봐선 놓치는 게 있는 거죠.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: 스위치 투는 구월 말까지 누적으로 이천육백만 대 넘게 팔렸어요. 덜 팔렸다는 말은, 출시 때 폭발적으로 팔린 작년과 비교한 거고요.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: 저도 판매가 줄었다길래 장사가 다 안 된 줄 알았어요. 아무튼 부럽네요. 저도 출근은 줄이고 월급은 늘리는 쪽으로 가고 싶거든요.

scenes.headline: 말했는데 더 궁금함
scenes.narration: 배역은 비밀인데, 배우는 고생했대요. 스칼렛 요한슨이 이번 배트맨 속편 얘기를 꺼냈거든요.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: 인터뷰에서 엑소시스트와 배트맨 중 뭐가 더 낯선 도전이었냐고 물었대요. 요한슨은 배트맨을 골랐고, 역할을 이해하기 어려웠다네요.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: 역할 때문인지 자기 삶의 시기 때문인지 모르겠지만, 불안도 컸대요. 잘 맞는 배역을 만났다는 익숙한 출연 소감과는 좀 다르죠.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: 그런데 거기까지 말하고, 무슨 캐릭터인지는 공개하지 않았어요. 배우도 어려웠다는데, 우리는 캐릭터 이름부터 모르는 상황인 거예요.

scenes.headline: Commentary
scenes.narration: 저는 인터뷰를 보면 궁금증이 좀 풀릴 줄 알았거든요. 배우가 고생했다는 얘기만 듣고 더 궁금해졌네요. 홍보는 참 묘하게 잘돼요.

commons-34705278-44ca0041.description: In Hangar AE at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, the Swift spacecraft waits for final removal of the protective cover (at top). Swift is a first-of-its-kind, multi-wavelength observatory dedicated to the study of gamma-ray burst (GRB) science. Its three instruments will work together to observe GRBs and afterglows in the gamma-ray, X-ray and optical wavebands. Swift is part of NASA’s medium explorer (MIDEX) program being developed by an international collaboration. During its nominal 2-year mission, Swift is expected to observe more than 200 bursts, which will represent the most comprehensive study of GRB afterglow to date. It is scheduled for launch into a low-Earth orbit on a Delta 7320 rocket on Oct. 7.

scenes.headline: The Election Ended. The Uncertainty Didn
scenes.narration: One election, two market moods. American stocks rallied on November fourth, then AI-linked shares helped lead a broad selloff the next day.

scenes.headline: The Election Ended. The Uncertainty Didn
scenes.narration: Democrats were reported to have won both chambers of Congress. That result wasn't an instant new rulebook for every data center.

scenes.headline: The Election Ended. The Uncertainty Didn
scenes.narration: Investors were weighing future oversight and expensive AI expansion. Those were expectations, not proof that every feared restriction had already become law.

scenes.headline: The Election Ended. The Uncertainty Didn
scenes.narration: My take is that an election headline isn't an investment thesis. Prices can move before policy does, and then change their minds.

scenes.headline: The Election Ended. The Uncertainty Didn
scenes.narration: Apparently the market wanted certainty. It got an election result, then immediately ordered a fresh serving of uncertainty.

scenes.headline: An AI Face, A Human Choice
scenes.narration: Whose choice was it? Grimes is reported to be joining Gods Don't Give Gifts, an AI-made film using her likeness and recorded voice.

scenes.headline: An AI Face, A Human Choice
scenes.narration: The important distinction isn't simply that software made the images. It's whether the performer chose the role and agreed to that use.

scenes.headline: An AI Face, A Human Choice
scenes.narration: Reports describe her vocal performance driving the character. That doesn't tell us her contract terms, payment, or what other material trained the tools.

scenes.headline: An AI Face, A Human Choice
scenes.narration: My take is that agreeing to one project isn't signing away your identity everywhere. Permission should have boundaries, even when the picture doesn't.

scenes.headline: An AI Face, A Human Choice

OpenAI’s user base doubled in just the past few weeks (an accidental disclosure on stage). “10% of the world now uses our systems a lot.”
Reflecting on the life ahead for his newborn: “My kids will never be smarter than AI.”
Reaction to DeepSeek:
“We had a meeting last night on our open source policy. We are going to do a powerful open-source model near the frontier. We were late to act, but we are going to do really well now.”
Regarding the accumulated knowledge OpenAI gains from its usage history: “The upload happens bit by bit. It is an extension of yourself, and a companion, and soon will proactively push things to you.”
Have there been any scary moments? 
“No. There have been moments of awe. And questions of how far this will go. But we are not sitting on a conscious model capable of self-improvement.”
How do you define AGI?
“If you ask 10 OpenAI engineers, you will get 14 different definitions. Whichever you choose, it is clear that we will go way past that. They are points along an unbelievable exponential curve.”
“Agentic AI is the most interesting and consequential safety problem we have faced. It has much higher stakes. People want to use agents they can trust.”
